integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled standard-library checker verifies the exact Q(sqrt(6)) convex decomposition and stabilizer local-commutation separability certificates; no finite numerical search is used as a substitute for the interval statement.
limitations: The result is a constructive sufficient bi-entangling threshold for the CNOT under independent replacement depolarization on the two output qubits. It does not prove that the displayed threshold is globally minimal over all bi-entangling decompositions or extend the same threshold to arbitrary two-qubit gates.
title: An explicit 62.02% bi-entangling certificate for the locally depolarized CNOT
